# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability
Resync deals with raw pointers and concurrency. Memory safety is our top priority.

If you have found a potential security vulnerability (e.g., data race, undefined behavior, soundness hole), please **do not open a public GitHub issue**.

Instead, please use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature on this repository, or email [Project Author](mailto:vi.is.chapmann@gmail.com). 

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you to resolve the issue before any public disclosure.
